tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch12:12-6↗ prop:path-homotopy-contains-minimizing-geodesic Suppose $(M,g)$ is a complete, connected Riemannian manifold, and $p,q \in M$. Proposition 6.25 showed that every path-homotopy class of paths from $p$ to $q$ contains a geodesic segment $\gamma $. Show that if $M$ has nonpositive sectional curvature, then $\gamma $ is the unique geodesic segment in the given path homotopy class. \end{exercise}
